name: AE JSX export artifact verification report schema
compatibility_classification: Measured standalone JSX artifact preflight contract

scope.purpose: Recalculate metadata binding and generated JSX body digest before manual approval review or manual AE execution.

artifact_accepted_for_manual_approval_re.meaning: The local files are internally consistent enough to review for a separate manual approval receipt; this is not permission to run AE.

notes: This preflight closes the gap between metadata-only manifest review and the actual generated JSX file on disk by hashing the local JSX artifact body.
A verified report is consistency evidence only; it is not an approval receipt and not tool-side execution permission.
The verifier must fail closed if the manifest binding, generated JSX path, byte length, body digest, or optional export report sidecar disagrees.
The report does not embed the generated JSX body, source snapshot JSON, private project payloads, or binary AEP data.
The tool does not launch AE, execute JSX, write .aep/.aepx projects, overwrite sources, or touch AEX/OFX/AviUtl core responsibilities.
